title: Plynth plan, version 6
description: Everything marked on a floor plan, including the furniture and generators placed on it. All lengths are in metres. x points right and y points down, as in the plan image, with the image's top left corner at (0, 0). Ids are unique across the whole file and never change. Plynth writes every field; other tools may leave out the fields that are not required, which then take the default shown. The left and right side of a wall are as seen on the plan looking from its from point toward its to point; right is the direction (-dy, dx), where (dx, dy) runs from the from point to the to point. Older files are upgraded when read: version 1 (plan.v1.schema.json) openings get hinge start and swing right, version 2 (plan.v2.schema.json) floors get an empty items list, version 3 (plan.v3.schema.json) rooms get wall_material null, version 4 (plan.v4.schema.json) floors get slab_thickness 0.2, image_offset (0, 0) and an empty stairs list, and the plan gets the default roof and an empty roof_sections list, and version 5 (plan.v5.schema.json) items get generator null. Floors are listed from the lowest up; each floor's level is the level of the one below plus its ceiling_height and slab_thickness. Materials are ids in the materials catalog; a face that names none uses the project default of project.json. Curved walls and rounded corners are true circular arcs; readers that need straight segments cut an arc of radius r and sweep a (radians) into the smallest count n of equal angle segments with a / n at most 7.5 degrees and r * (1 - cos(a / (2n))) at most 0.005 m, with n from 2 to 256.

roof.description: The settings of every roof section that has no entry in roof_sections. Roof sections are not drawn: every part of a floor with no part of the next floor above it gets one.

roof_sections.description: Roof sections with settings of their own. Each is tied to the section of its floor that holds its anchor (x, y); an entry whose anchor lies in no section is kept and reported as unused.

name.description: A catalog or registry name such as a material, room type, asset or opening shape.

pixels_per_metre.description: Plan image pixels per metre. null until the scale is set.

name.description: Shown on the floor tab. Defaults to the id.

image.description: Plan image path relative to the project folder, with forward slashes, for example plans/floor1.png. null when the floor has no image.

slab_thickness.description: The slab between this floor's ceiling and the next floor or the roof.

image_offset.description: Where the floor's plan image sits: image pixel (px, py) is at (px / pixels_per_metre + x, py / pixels_per_metre + y). Lets an upper floor's image line up with the floor below. Every floor uses the one scale.

stairs.description: Stairs from this floor up to the next floor. Marked once, on the lower floor.

stair.description: A stair. The step count and footprint are worked out from the floor heights: the rise is ceiling_height plus slab_thickness of its floor, cut into equal risers of at most 0.19 m, with treads 0.27 m deep. A floor that is the top one cannot hold a working stair; Plynth reports it.

type.description: A stair type id. Built in: straight, l_shape, u_shape, spiral. A reader without that type should report it rather than refuse the file.

x.description: The middle of the front edge of the bottom step.

rotation.description: The climb direction, in degrees clockwise as seen on the plan. At 0 the stair climbs toward +y, the same way an item's front faces.

turn.description: Which way an L or U shaped stair turns and a spiral winds, as seen on the plan while climbing.

type.description: A roof type id. Built in: flat (with a parapet), gable, hip, shed, sawtooth. A reader without that type should report it rather than refuse the file.

pitch.description: Degrees above horizontal. Used by pitched types.

overhang.description: How far the roof reaches past the outer wall faces. A flat roof with a parapet has none.

parapet.description: Height of the low wall round a flat roof. 0 for none.

direction.description: Degrees clockwise on the plan from +x: the ridge of a gable or sawtooth roof runs along it, a shed roof falls toward it. null: along the longer side of the section's bounding box.

x.description: The anchor: the section of the floor that holds it uses these settings.

material.description: The roof covering. null: the project's roof default, or flat_roof for a flat roof.

corner_radius.description: Rounds the corner with an arc touching the centre lines of both walls. Only used when the point joins exactly two straight walls meeting at an angle between 1 and 179 degrees. The arc meets each wall r / tan(angle / 2) from the point; the radius is made smaller when needed so that distance is at most half of each wall's length. 0 is a sharp corner.

from.description: A point on the same floor.

to.description: Another point on the same floor.

height.description: Overrides the floor's ceiling height, for half walls. null uses the ceiling height.

bulge.description: Bends the wall into a circular arc through both points: signed distance from the middle of the straight line to the middle of the arc. Positive bends toward the right side. 0 is straight, and a size below 0.001 counts as straight. Plynth keeps it at most half the straight length either way (a half circle). Lengths and offsets along a curved wall are measured along the arc.

material_inside.description: Used on every face of this wall that looks into a room, on both sides of a wall between two rooms. null: the room's wall_material, then the project's wall_inside default.

material_outside.description: Used on every face of this wall that looks into no room. null: the project's wall_outside default.

type.description: A room type id, for example living, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, hall, dining, office, storage or other. The list is user editable, so readers accept any well formed name. null until the user picks a type.

walls.description: Walls on the same floor that bound the room: the outer ring in order, then the ring of each island inside it.

wall_material.description: Used on the wall faces that look into this room when the wall has no material_inside. null: the project's wall_inside default.

wall.description: A wall on the same floor.

offset.description: Distance along the wall (along the arc for a curved wall) from its from point to the centre of the opening.

shape.description: An opening shape id. Built in: rectangle, round_arch, flat_arch, pointed_arch, circle. Other ids are custom shapes from the user's Library/shapes folder (shape.schema.json); a reader without that shape should report it rather than refuse the file.

width.description: Measured along the wall, the same way as offset.

sill.description: Height of the bottom of the opening above the floor.

hinge.description: The jamb a door hangs on: start is the one nearer the wall's from point, end the one nearer its to point. Kept for every type; only doors use it.

swing.description: The side of the wall a door opens toward. Kept for every type; only doors use it.

frame.description: A catalog asset fitted to the opening. null for none.

generatorId.description: A generator, parameter or choice id: lower case letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.

generatorUse.description: The generator an item runs instead of placing an asset, and its parameter values. Numbers are metres or degrees; null is an empty value (for a material, the neutral look). Whether the generator exists and the values fit its declaration (generator.schema.json) is not a format rule; Plynth reports it as a warning.

name.description: The generator id: the file stem of Library/generators/<name>.py. Kept even when the library on this machine does not have it.

item.description: A catalog asset or a generator placed on the floor. Exactly one of asset and generator is set. Its footprint is the rectangle of width by depth centred at (x, y) and turned by rotation. Whether it fits its room or overlaps other things is not a format rule; Plynth reports it as a warning.

asset.description: The asset id in the assets catalog, or null for a generator item. Kept even when the library on this machine does not have it.

room.description: The room on the same floor the item stands in. null when it stands in no room.

x.description: Centre of the footprint, where the asset's bottom centre goes.

z.description: Height of the asset's bottom above the floor.

rotation.description: Degrees, clockwise as seen on the plan. At 0 the asset's front faces +y (down the plan image). In Blender (x, -y, z axes) this is a turn of -rotation about z.

wall.description: For a wall-mounted item, the wall on the same floor it hangs on. Its back lies flush against the face of that wall on the side its centre is on, facing away from the wall. null for an item standing on the floor.

size.description: The asset's measured size when it was placed or last swapped, or the size the generator makes with its values: width along its own x, depth along its own y (back to front), height up.

generator.description: Set for a generator item, null for an asset item.
